description: Source code for the ConnectJob class in the net:: namespace, managing network connection attempts including socket setup, timeout handling, and delegate notifications.

classes.name: CommonConnectJobParams
classes.description: Holds parameters shared across connect jobs, such as socket factory, resolver, and security settings.

classes.name: ConnectJob
classes.description: Manages the process of establishing a network connection, including socket creation, timeout handling, and delegate notifications.

methods.name: ConnectJob::Connect
methods.description: Initiates the connection process, starts timeout timer, and logs the start event.

methods.name: ConnectJob::PassSocket
methods.description: Transfers ownership of the established socket to the caller.

methods.name: ConnectJob::ChangePriority
methods.description: Changes the priority of the connection attempt.

methods.name: ConnectJob::GetConnectionAttempts
methods.description: Returns the list of connection attempts made (default empty).

methods.name: ConnectJob::IsSSLError
methods.description: Indicates if the current error is SSL-related.

methods.name: ConnectJob::GetCertRequestInfo
methods.description: Retrieves SSL certificate request info if applicable.

methods.name: ConnectJob::set_done_closure
methods.description: Sets a callback to be run upon completion.

methods.name: ConnectJob::GetHostResolverEndpointResult
methods.description: Returns optional host resolver endpoint result.

methods.name: ConnectJob::SetSocket
methods.description: Sets the socket for the connection and logs the event.

methods.name: ConnectJob::NotifyDelegateOfCompletion
methods.description: Notifies delegate of connection completion and logs the result.

methods.name: ConnectJob::NotifyDelegateOfProxyAuth
methods.description: Notifies delegate that proxy authentication is needed.

methods.name: ConnectJob::ResetTimer
methods.description: Resets the timeout timer with remaining time.

methods.name: ConnectJob::TimerIsRunning
methods.description: Checks if the timeout timer is active.

methods.name: ConnectJob::LogConnectStart
methods.description: Logs the start of a connection attempt.

methods.name: ConnectJob::LogConnectCompletion
methods.description: Logs the completion of a connection attempt with error code.

methods.name: ConnectJob::OnTimeout
methods.description: Handles connection timeout, cleans up socket, logs timeout, and notifies delegate.

methods.name: ConnectJob::OnTimedOutInternal
methods.description: Internal timeout handling, meant to be overridden if needed.
